commentary_segments.text_raw:
All analog circuits are built
up by means of a limit-
ed number of elementary
building blocks. Thorough
knowledge of these blocks is
therefore essential to obtain
insight into more compli-
cated circuit schematics.
This is why they are consid-
ered separately and ana-
lyzed in great detail. Several
overview slides are added so
as not to lose the context
out of sight.
commentary_segments.text: All analog circuits are built up by means of a limited number of elementary building blocks. Thorough knowledge of these blocks is therefore essential to obtain insight into more complicated circuit schematics. This is why they are considered separately and analyzed in great detail. Several overview slides are added so as not to lose the context out of sight.
